description: Figr is an AI design tool for product teams. It creates UI, stores your design system, and tracks the reasoning behind your product decisions. This MCP lets ChatGPT read your Figr projects. Open any design, extract artifact code, search your UX library, and use your product context in any conversation.

defaultPrompt: Give me a quick walkthrough of my Figr project: the screens, artifacts, and how everything fits together.
Open the sidebar navigation component, and show me the code and walk me through the thinking behind it.
Use my projects as context to write a spec for a team permissions screen where admins can invite members
